name: restore_task
description: Restore one deleted Sunsama task the user named, returning it to where it was before deletion. Use this only when the user asks to bring back a specific task they deleted; it is not a way to undo other changes, un-complete a task (use mark_task_as_incomplete), or recover another person's tasks. Confirm the task's title with the user before calling, since a restored task reappears in shared views.

taskId.description: The ID of the task to restore
